purpose: Eliminate the entire polynomially tractable rank-2 layer before attacking rank-3 clauses. Given an arbitrary mixed 2/3-CNF, existentially project its 2-CNF part onto only the variables that occur in 3-clauses. The projection is again bijunctive and has an explicit O(k^2)-clause implication representation, where k is the number of 3-clauses.

input.formula: F=F2 AND F3, where F2 contains clauses of size at most two and F3 contains exactly the 3-clauses.
input.terminal_variables: T is the set of Boolean variables appearing in F3, so |T|<=3k.

construction.step_1: Build the implication graph G of F2 and compute SCCs/reachability. If some literal l and its negation lie in one SCC, F2 and hence F are UNSAT.
construction.step_2: For every pair of terminal literals a,b with a path a -> b in G, add the binary clause (NOT a OR b). Unit consequences are included as the special case a -> NOT a or NOT a -> a, represented by duplicated literals if desired.
construction.projected_2cnf: Call the resulting formula H_T. It uses only variables T and has O(|T|^2)=O(k^2) binary clauses after deduplication.

theorem.name: EXACT_RANK3_TERMINAL_BIJUNCTIVE_PROJECTION_KERNEL
theorem.statement: F is satisfiable iff K(F) is satisfiable. Moreover every satisfying assignment of K(F) can be extended to a satisfying assignment of F in polynomial time.
proof: The set of assignments to T extendable to a model of F2 is the existential projection of the bijunctive relation defined by F2. Bijunctive relations are closed under existential projection, so this projected relation is definable by 2-CNF.

For 2-CNF, an implication a -> b is entailed exactly when b is reachable from a in the implication graph, after the usual SCC consistency check. Therefore H_T contains all binary/unit implicates over terminal literals and defines exactly the projected relation on T.
If F is satisfiable, its restriction to T satisfies H_T and also all original 3-clauses F3, so it satisfies K(F).

Conversely, if an assignment tau on T satisfies K(F), then tau satisfies the exact projection H_T and therefore extends to an assignment sigma satisfying F2. Since F3 depends only on T and tau satisfies F3, sigma satisfies all of F.
To reconstruct sigma, add the terminal literals fixed by tau as unit clauses to F2 and run ordinary 2-SAT/SCC assignment reconstruction; exact projection guarantees consistency.

complexity.construction: polynomial time by SCC plus transitive reachability on the implication condensation graph
complexity.reconstruction: one polynomial 2-SAT solve after a terminal model is found

interpretation.positive: All variables and clauses belonging only to the rank-2 layer can be removed exactly. Any universal algorithm may therefore focus on a compact terminal system consisting of k rank-3 clauses plus their induced bijunctive implication relation.
interpretation.not_a_solver: k can be linear in the input size. Brute-force over terminal assignments or 3-clause choices remains exponential and is forbidden as a D1 algorithm.
interpretation.source_return_control: On the canonical Tovey bounded-occurrence normalization, projecting the link-cycle 2-clauses contracts the copy variables back to the original arbitrary 3-SAT variables. Thus this kernelization is exact cleanup, not hidden tractability.

next_target.name: E8_TERMINAL_RANK3_GLOBAL_CONTRACTION_V3_8
next_target.directive: Work only on K(F)=H_T AND F3: at most 3k terminal variables, an explicit bijunctive implication closure H_T, and k genuine 3-clauses. Seek a deterministic polynomial contraction/minimax invariant that handles all k rank-3 atoms simultaneously without branching on their three choices. Any claimed progress must beat the trivial 3^k terminal enumeration and survive Tovey source-return controls.
